requiredAssets.prompt: Create one original game background illustration for the preschool Dino Island feeding garden. Landscape 3:2. Style reference is the attached project original baby dinosaur: thick smooth dark outlines, emerald green, warm cream #F6F3EC, gold #b8923a, rounded cheerful simple shapes and restrained soft shading. No characters in background. Wide open pale cream-sage meadow occupying lower 70%, empty central interaction area for five large dinosaur sprites. Top and outer corners contain rounded orchard trees, a few golden fruit shapes and broad friendly prehistoric leaves, distant low hills and very light cream sky. Important decoration in top 25% and outermost 10%. No food on meadow, plates, numbers, text, symbols, interface, watermark, buildings, fences, people or scary elements. Finished clean 2D children storybook environment, not poster, photo or 3D. Opaque full-bleed background.
requiredAssets.review: Inspected: clean open centre, no text or characters, original thick-outline cream/green/gold environment. Touch and completion overlay checked separately.

requiredAssets.prompt: Match the actual supplied Dino Island website character reference: rounded preschool storybook 2D cartoon, thick dark outlines, emerald green, cream #F6F3EC and gold #b8923a, soft simple shading, large readable shapes. Single full-body sprite, front three-quarter view, friendly expression, centered, 8 percent clear margins, genuine transparent background. Match referenced character except new dinosaur friends which are distinct species in the same visual world. Intended for math gameplay. No ground shadow.
